text.p: Liposome Co Inc said early Wednesday that the Phase III study of its Ventus drug to treat acute respiratory distress syndrome showed no difference between patients receiving the drug or a placebo.
The company said no difference was seen in reducing the time on mechanical ventilation or in 28-day mortality. In addition, no safety concerns for the drug were found, it said.

"We are very disappointed in the results of this study," Chairman and Chief Executive Charles Baker said in a statement. "We will continue to evaluate the drug to determine whether it can play a role in the treatment of patients with ARDS. We will also continue to evaluate whether it may be useful in other clinical settings."
Liposome is a biopharmaceutical company developing and marketing products based on lipid technology.
